tools.name: codevideo_instructions_to_create_a_course
tools.description: Instructions for building a multi-lesson course as one JSON object passed between tool calls (the older flow: codevideo_create_course_with_initial_metadata, then codevideo_add_lesson_to_course per lesson). For new courses prefer the server-side flow in codevideo_instructions_to_build_course_from_scratch.

additionalContext.description: What to build, in your own words: the lessons for a course, or the topic for a lesson.

tools.name: codevideo_instructions_to_create_lesson_actions
tools.description: Instructions for writing the actions of a single lesson: the action reference, the authoring rules, and how to store and render the result.

additionalContext.description: What to build, in your own words: the lessons for a course, or the topic for a lesson.

tools.name: codevideo_instructions_to_create_lesson_video
tools.description: Instructions for writing a single lesson and rendering it to video, either from an actions array (codevideo_make_video_from_actions) or from a full lesson object with snapshots (codevideo_make_video_from_lesson).

additionalContext.description: What to build, in your own words: the lessons for a course, or the topic for a lesson.

tools.name: codevideo_instructions_to_translate_actions
tools.description: Generate translation instructions for CodeVideo actions. Pass actions array OR use previously stored actions from codevideo_set_current_actions (recommended workflow).

actionsToTranslation.description: Array of CodeVideo actions to translate. Optional if actions were previously stored with codevideo_set_current_actions

tools.name: codevideo_get_empty_lesson_snapshot
tools.description: An empty course snapshot (no files, editors or terminal output) as JSON, to use as the initialSnapshot of a lesson that starts from nothing.

tools.name: codevideo_create_course_with_initial_metadata
tools.description: Returns a new course object as JSON (id, name, description, primaryLanguage, no lessons) for the older flow where the course JSON is passed between tool calls. Nothing is stored; the server-side flow uses codevideo_create_course.

tools.name: codevideo_add_actions_to_lesson
tools.description: Sets a lesson object's actions, replacing any it had, and returns the updated lesson as JSON. Nothing is stored; for stored courses use codevideo_set_lesson_actions.

tools.name: codevideo_get_final_lesson_snapshot
tools.description: Get the final state snapshot after applying CodeVideo actions. Pass actions array OR use previously stored actions from codevideo_set_current_actions (recommended workflow).

actions.description: Array of CodeVideo actions to apply. Optional if actions were previously stored with codevideo_set_current_actions

tools.name: codevideo_add_lesson_to_course
tools.description: Appends a new, empty lesson (id, name, description, an empty initial snapshot) to a course object and returns the updated course as JSON. Nothing is stored; for stored courses use codevideo_add_lesson.

tools.name: codevideo_get_action_names
tools.description: Every CodeVideo action, one per line: what it does and what its value takes. Check the rows for the actions you plan to use.

tools.name: codevideo_get_example_actions_array_by_keyword
tools.description: An example actions array as JSON for a keyword: javascript, js, console log or log; go, golang, golang console log or golang log; python, python console log or python log. Returns an empty string when nothing matches.

keyword.description: One of the keywords listed in this tool's description.

tools.name: codevideo_get_example_lesson_by_keyword
tools.description: An example lesson as JSON (a Go CLI tool explored from an existing codebase) for the keyword go, golang, explore codebase, existing codebase or go cli tool. Returns an empty string when nothing matches.

keyword.description: One of the keywords listed in this tool's description.

tools.name: codevideo_get_initial_lesson_state_from_local_repo
tools.description: Create an initial lesson state snapshot from a local repository/codebase directory. This captures the file structure and creates an empty lesson template ready for action recording.

repoLocation.description: Local file system path to the repository/codebase directory

tools.name: codevideo_get_initial_lesson_state_from_github_repo
tools.description: Create an initial lesson state snapshot from a GitHub repository URL. This fetches the repository content, captures the file structure, and creates an empty lesson template ready for action recording.

tools.name: codevideo_make_markdown_from_actions
tools.description: Generate a markdown blog post from CodeVideo actions array. Pass actions array OR use previously stored actions from codevideo_set_current_actions (recommended workflow).

actions.description: Array of CodeVideo actions. Optional if actions were previously stored with codevideo_set_current_actions

tools.name: codevideo_make_markdown_from_lesson
tools.description: Generate a markdown blog post from a complete lesson object. Pass a lesson object OR use previously stored lesson from lesson management tools. This extracts the actions from the lesson and generates markdown.

lesson.description: Complete lesson object. Optional if lesson was previously stored with lesson management tools

tools.name: codevideo_make_html_web_page
tools.description: Generate an HTML web page from CodeVideo actions. Pass actions array OR use previously stored actions from codevideo_set_current_actions (recommended workflow).

actions.description: Array of CodeVideo actions. Optional if actions were previously stored with codevideo_set_current_actions

tools.name: codevideo_make_video_from_actions
tools.description: Render a video from CodeVideo actions: pass actions, or omit them to use the ones stored with codevideo_set_current_actions. Queues a background render job and returns its jobId at once; follow it with codevideo_get_render_job.

actions.description: Array of CodeVideo actions. Optional if actions were previously stored with codevideo_set_current_actions

orientation.description: Video orientation; portrait renders 1080x1920. For portrait, usually also set isFileExplorerVisible, isEditorTabsVisible, isMinimapVisible and isMouseVisible to false.

isMouseVisible.description: Draw the mouse cursor. Mouse actions keep their timing and effects when it's hidden.

isDiagnosticsVisible.description: Show TypeScript squiggles (red errors, yellow warnings) for the whole video. editor-show-diagnostics / editor-hide-diagnostics actions switch them for part of a lesson instead.

voiceId.description: ElevenLabs voice ID for the narration.

renderMode.description: realtime (default) records the browser as it plays; deterministic renders frame by frame.

renderSeed.description: Deterministic renders only: a seed for reproducible output.

options.description: Render options: orientation, IDE layout (theme, font size, which panes and the cursor are visible), pacing, voice and render mode.

open.description: Open the finished video in the default player. Defaults to true.

tools.name: codevideo_make_video_from_lesson
tools.description: Render a video from a complete lesson object: pass the lesson, or omit it to use the one stored with codevideo_set_current_lesson. Queues a background render job and returns its jobId at once; follow it with codevideo_get_render_job. For lessons in a stored course, use codevideo_render_lesson_video instead.

lesson.description: Complete lesson object with snapshots. Optional if lesson was previously stored with lesson management tools

orientation.description: Video orientation; portrait renders 1080x1920. For portrait, usually also set isFileExplorerVisible, isEditorTabsVisible, isMinimapVisible and isMouseVisible to false.

isMouseVisible.description: Draw the mouse cursor. Mouse actions keep their timing and effects when it's hidden.

isDiagnosticsVisible.description: Show TypeScript squiggles (red errors, yellow warnings) for the whole video. editor-show-diagnostics / editor-hide-diagnostics actions switch them for part of a lesson instead.

voiceId.description: ElevenLabs voice ID for the narration.

renderMode.description: realtime (default) records the browser as it plays; deterministic renders frame by frame.

renderSeed.description: Deterministic renders only: a seed for reproducible output.

options.description: Render options: orientation, IDE layout (theme, font size, which panes and the cursor are visible), pacing, voice and render mode.

open.description: Open the finished video in the default player. Defaults to true.

tools.name: codevideo_validate_actions
tools.description: Checks a list of actions: unknown names, values of the wrong kind, and actions lessons can't use, each with what to do instead.

tools.name: codevideo_is_repeatable_action
tools.description: Whether an action's value is a repeat count (how many times to press the key or run the step) rather than text. Returns true or false.

tools.name: codevideo_critique_video_using_gemini
tools.description: Critique a generated video using Google Gemini AI. Pass actions array OR use previously stored actions from codevideo_set_current_actions (recommended workflow).

videoPath.description: Path to the video file to critique

actions.description: Array of CodeVideo actions used to generate the video. Optional if actions were previously stored with codevideo_set_current_actions

tools.name: codevideo_set_current_actions
tools.description: Legacy single-slot store: keep one actions array for later tool calls, so they can run without re-sending it. Every conversation shares this one slot. For courses or several lessons, use codevideo_create_course and the course tools, which keep work apart by id.

actions.description: Array of CodeVideo actions to store for later use

tools.name: codevideo_get_current_actions
tools.description: Legacy single-slot store: read back the actions stored with codevideo_set_current_actions (shared by every conversation).

tools.name: codevideo_set_current_lesson
tools.description: Legacy single-slot store: keep one lesson object for later tool calls, so they can run without re-sending it. Every conversation shares this one slot. For courses or several lessons, use codevideo_create_course and the course tools, which keep work apart by id.

lesson.description: Complete lesson object to store for later use

tools.name: codevideo_get_current_lesson
tools.description: Legacy single-slot store: read back the lesson stored with codevideo_set_current_lesson (shared by every conversation).

tools.name: codevideo_instructions_to_build_course_from_scratch
tools.description: Get step-by-step instructions for building a COMPLETE multi-lesson 'build from scratch' course with the course-store tools (snapshots stay server-side). Use this before authoring a full course.

additionalContext.description: What the course should teach / build

tools.name: codevideo_create_course
tools.description: Create a new course (server-side, returns a courseId). Snapshots and lesson state live in the MCP, not in your context.

tools.name: codevideo_add_lesson
tools.description: Add a lesson to a course. By default it continues from the previous lesson's final state (chained server-side). Set mustCompile:false for slideshow/discussion/half-refactor lessons. The reply includes the previous lesson's name and description, for the recap that opens this lesson.

tools.name: codevideo_set_lesson_actions
tools.description: Store a lesson's actions, replacing any it had. The server recomputes the lesson's final snapshot and re-chains following lessons. Returns only a small ack (no snapshot). To change part of a lesson later, use codevideo_edit_lesson_actions instead of sending every action again.

tools.name: codevideo_edit_lesson_actions
tools.description: Change part of a lesson without re-sending it: each edit removes deleteCount actions at start and inserts the given ones there, like Array.splice. Edits apply in order (each start refers to the actions as the previous edits left them), all or nothing, with one snapshot recompute. Use codevideo_get_lesson_actions to find indices.

start.description: Index of the first action to change

deleteCount.description: How many actions to remove at start (0 to only insert)

tools.name: codevideo_get_lesson_actions
tools.description: Read part of a lesson's actions with their indices (default: the first 50), e.g. to find what to change with codevideo_edit_lesson_actions.

tools.name: codevideo_get_lesson_file_tree
tools.description: List the file paths present at the END of a lesson (cheap; no file contents, no snapshot).

tools.name: codevideo_get_lesson_file
tools.description: Get the contents of ONE file at the END of a lesson (cheap targeted read instead of dumping the whole snapshot).

tools.name: codevideo_compile_lesson
tools.description: Replay a lesson and verify its saved end-state projects offline. Returns passed, failed, blocked, or unsupported, with check kinds and actionable issues. Monaco diagnostics are presentation-only; dirty buffers prevent a pass.

tools.name: codevideo_validate_course
tools.description: Validate actions, continuity, diagnostic hovers, copy/cut/paste presses that would do nothing, and fresh saved-file project verification. Every mustCompile lesson and the final lesson must have outcome passed; blocked/unsupported/dirty/stale states prevent done:true.

tools.name: codevideo_get_course_status
tools.description: Resumable checkpoint view of a course: lessons, action counts, estimated video length per lesson, flags — without pulling any snapshot.

tools.name: codevideo_export_course
tools.description: Export the full course (ICourse with snapshots) to a JSON file under ~/.codevideo/exports and return its path. The course itself isn't returned, so it doesn't fill your context.

tools.name: codevideo_generate_lesson_preview
tools.description: Generate a server-side HTML preview of a single lesson (open in a browser to eyeball it). Cheap; no video.

tools.name: codevideo_generate_course_previews
tools.description: Generate HTML previews for every lesson — GATED: only works once codevideo_validate_course returns done. Use for human review before rendering video.

tools.name: codevideo_render_lesson_video
tools.description: Render ONE lesson of a stored course to video: queues a background render job and returns its jobId. GATED: refuses until codevideo_validate_course returns done.

orientation.description: Video orientation; portrait renders 1080x1920. For portrait, usually also set isFileExplorerVisible, isEditorTabsVisible, isMinimapVisible and isMouseVisible to false.

isMouseVisible.description: Draw the mouse cursor. Mouse actions keep their timing and effects when it's hidden.

isDiagnosticsVisible.description: Show TypeScript squiggles (red errors, yellow warnings) for the whole video. editor-show-diagnostics / editor-hide-diagnostics actions switch them for part of a lesson instead.

voiceId.description: ElevenLabs voice ID for the narration.

renderMode.description: realtime (default) records the browser as it plays; deterministic renders frame by frame.

renderSeed.description: Deterministic renders only: a seed for reproducible output.

options.description: Render options: orientation, IDE layout (theme, font size, which panes and the cursor are visible), pacing, voice and render mode.

open.description: Open the finished video in the default player. Defaults to true.

tools.name: codevideo_render_course_videos
tools.description: Render every lesson of a stored course to video: queues one background render job per lesson, run one at a time in lesson order. GATED: refuses until codevideo_validate_course returns done. Run only after a human approves the previews.

orientation.description: Video orientation; portrait renders 1080x1920. For portrait, usually also set isFileExplorerVisible, isEditorTabsVisible, isMinimapVisible and isMouseVisible to false.

isMouseVisible.description: Draw the mouse cursor. Mouse actions keep their timing and effects when it's hidden.

isDiagnosticsVisible.description: Show TypeScript squiggles (red errors, yellow warnings) for the whole video. editor-show-diagnostics / editor-hide-diagnostics actions switch them for part of a lesson instead.

voiceId.description: ElevenLabs voice ID for the narration.

renderMode.description: realtime (default) records the browser as it plays; deterministic renders frame by frame.

renderSeed.description: Deterministic renders only: a seed for reproducible output.

options.description: Render options: orientation, IDE layout (theme, font size, which panes and the cursor are visible), pacing, voice and render mode.

open.description: Open the finished video in the default player. Defaults to false.

tools.name: codevideo_get_render_job
tools.description: Status of one render job: queued (with how many jobs are ahead), running (with the latest progress line), succeeded (the video exists at outputPath), failed (with the CLI's error), cancelled or interrupted. Includes the last lines of the CLI's log.

tools.name: codevideo_list_render_jobs
tools.description: Recent render jobs, newest first (default 20), optionally for one course or in one status.

tools.name: codevideo_cancel_render_job
tools.description: Cancel one render job, or every unfinished render job of a course. Queued jobs are dropped; a running one is stopped along with its browser.
